explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because .format(url) interpolates url directly inside single quotes in the SELECT query. Crafted URL strings could escape the literal and execute unintended SQL against the database. The repair passes args={'url':url} to self.db.exec(sql, args) with quoted '{url}' in SQL, which cannot be verified as safe without seeing self.db.exec and resembles string formatting.
